_comment: The extension list for pocketone.dev. Every ext/<name> folder must be listed here; site/sync fails otherwise. Each README becomes /docs/extensions/<name>; other top-level .md files in the extension folder become guides under it. Entries with "link" have no README and point at that file on GitHub instead.

groups.title: Standard extensions
groups.intro: These ship with `pocketone` and add no work to an app that doesn't use them.

groups.title: Run many instances
groups.intro: Host hundreds of PocketBase instances in one process, across regions.

groups.title: Services for your instances
groups.intro: Shared services a host gives every instance it runs.

groups.title: Sell it as a service
groups.intro: Accounts, quotas and billing, for running PocketBase as a service.

groups.title: For extension authors
groups.intro: The extension contract and tools for building and testing extensions.

extensions.name: pitr
extensions.title: PITR
extensions.summary: Point-in-time restore of your database with Litestream. On by default.

extensions.name: autotls
extensions.title: Auto TLS
extensions.summary: Certificates on demand and wildcards through ACME.

extensions.name: bulkmail
extensions.title: Bulk Mail
extensions.summary: Campaigns to your app's own users, with audiences from a collection, a view or SQL.

extensions.name: pages
extensions.title: Pages
extensions.summary: Server-rendered pages from a pb_pages folder (formerly PocketPages).

extensions.name: vacuum
extensions.title: Vacuum
extensions.summary: Scheduled SQLite VACUUM.

extensions.name: mcp
extensions.title: MCP
extensions.summary: An MCP endpoint at /mcp so agents can manage your app and call its tools.

extensions.name: oauth-server
extensions.title: OAuth Server
extensions.summary: Your app as an OAuth provider; pocketone login and MCP sign-in use it.

extensions.name: s3redirect
extensions.title: S3 Redirect
extensions.summary: File downloads as short-lived signed S3 redirects.

extensions.name: tokens
extensions.title: Tokens
extensions.summary: Long-lived API tokens with scopes.

extensions.name: deploy
extensions.title: Deploy
extensions.summary: pocketone deploy, dev, pull and logs, and the deploy API.

extensions.name: remotes
extensions.title: Remotes
extensions.summary: Named remotes and saved logins for the pocketone command.

extensions.name: upgrade
extensions.title: Upgrade
extensions.summary: pocketone upgrade to the latest release, keeping the old executable.

extensions.name: config
extensions.title: Config
extensions.summary: The pocketone.yaml config file, with secrets in a .env beside it.

extensions.name: jserrors
extensions.title: JS Errors
extensions.summary: JS hook errors that name the pb_hooks file and line.

extensions.name: multisite-provider-pocker
extensions.title: Pocker
extensions.summary: Hundreds of PocketBase instances in one Go process, routed by hostname.

extensions.name: multisite
extensions.title: Multisite
extensions.summary: Many instances behind one listener, routed by hostname, run by one provider.

extensions.name: multisite-provider-docker
extensions.title: Docker
extensions.summary: A host provider that runs each instance in its own container.

extensions.name: sandbox
extensions.title: Sandbox
extensions.summary: Confines untrusted JS hooks, SQL and outbound network.

extensions.name: multisite-firewall
extensions.title: Firewall
extensions.summary: Peer allow-lists, trusted proxies and rate limits for a host.

extensions.name: multisite-edge
extensions.title: Edge
extensions.summary: Forwards each request to the edge that owns the instance.

extensions.name: multisite-mothership
extensions.title: Mothership
extensions.summary: A control plane and its edges, across regions.

extensions.name: multisite-schedules
extensions.title: Schedules
extensions.summary: Scheduled webhooks that wake sleeping instances.

extensions.name: multisite-stats
extensions.title: Stats
extensions.summary: Measures disk use and last request for each instance a host serves.

extensions.name: multisite-mailrelay
extensions.title: Mail Relay
extensions.summary: Outgoing mail for instances without SMTP, through your relay, with limits.

extensions.name: multisite-s3-fallback
extensions.title: S3 Fallback
extensions.summary: A default bucket for uploads and backups when an instance has no S3 of its own.

extensions.name: multisite-servertiming
extensions.title: Server Timing
extensions.summary: Server-Timing headers for each step of a request.

extensions.name: multisite-tenants
extensions.title: Multitenant
extensions.summary: Accounts that own instances: quotas, owner logins, tokens and an API.

extensions.name: multisite-tenant-billing
extensions.title: Multitenant Billing
extensions.summary: Plans, quotas and the billing provider hook for Multitenant.

extensions.name: multisite-tenant-billing-ls
extensions.title: Lemon Squeezy Adapter
extensions.summary: Lemon Squeezy as the billing provider.

extensions.name: extkit
extensions.title: Extension Kit
extensions.summary: The extension contract: one extension works on a single app and under pocker.

extensions.name: mailtrap
extensions.title: Mail Trap
extensions.summary: Dev mode: mail from an app without SMTP lands in a built-in inbox.

extensions.name: devusers
extensions.title: Dev Users
extensions.summary: Local testing only: a superuser and a user with password "password".

extensions.name: jsembed
extensions.title: JS Embed
extensions.summary: JS hooks and migrations embedded in the binary.
